snapshots.why: Final DC4Ever tree (C#). Real dates 2003-2005: history rebuilt in 2019 from backups, one commit per file at its mtime; README commits 2019 excluded
snapshots.date_note: Real development 2003-2005 (C#, .NET). The GitHub repo was created 2019-04-11; its history was rebuilt from backups as one commit per file stamped with the file mtime (2002-01-30 .. 2005-09-15). Commit dates are therefore approximate file dates, not real commits.
